name: id_report_loss
description: Protected. Record the caller's confirmed loss declaration and block their old national ID card at once (ID-01). Only after reading back when and where it was lost and hearing a clear yes. Returns loss_ref and card_status.

lost_days_ago.description: How many days ago it was lost: 0 today, 1 yesterday (jana), 2 the day before. Use this when the caller gives a relative day

lost_on.description: Only if the caller gave a calendar date: YYYY-MM-DD

location_description.description: Where it was lost, in a few of the caller's words

kind.description: stolen if the caller says it was stolen or is being misused

confirmation_id.description: Only on country agents: leave empty the first time; after the caller says yes to the read-back, call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id you were given.
